subject: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@stellaris.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-25T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite

Hi Simon — thanks again for the quick discovery earlier today. Quick recap: we covered your high-level goals (reduce per-token cost for customer-facing agents, ensure EU data residency for PHI-adjacent logs, and patterns of traffic spikes at end-of-month).

I noticed you mentioned you never received the calendar invite for the technical deep-dive — sorry about that. It looks like our meeting URLs rotated after a platform update and the original invite likely pointed to an old link.

To get a firm next step, can you confirm your timezone (I have CET listed for you) and which of these windows would work for a 60-minute deep dive focused on throughput, routing, and private deployment options? I converted to CET below: 
- Tues Mar 2, 10:00–11:00 CET (16:00–17:00 SGT)
- Wed Mar 3, 09:00–10:00 CET
- Thu Mar 4, 14:00–15:00 CET

If none work, share two alternatives and I’ll send a corrected invite with a stable Redwood meeting URL and an ICS attached. I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short product map (MAP) to give your engs context ahead of the deep dive.

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — I’ll stay flexible.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
www.redwood.ai
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@stellaris.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@stellaris.io>
Date: 2027-02-25T16:20:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite

Thanks, Irene.

Confirming: I’m CET (Amsterdam) — apologies for the confusion. I did not receive the original invite; I only saw a brief calendar note that did not include a working join URL.

Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 CET works for me. I’m going to loop in Anna (engineering lead) — she’ll want to cover expected throughput, KV cache behavior, and our compliance expectations (SOC-like audit trails).

Also: we have SSO for meeting tools internally; please let me know if the Redwood meeting link requires any special guest setup.

Simon Liu
Head of Platform Engineering | Stellaris Health
simon.liu@stellaris.io
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@stellaris.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-26T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite

Hi Simon — great, thanks for confirming CET and the Tue slot. I’ve created a new invite and corrected the join URL; please accept the attached ICS and use the link labelled "Redwood secure meeting link v2". We rotated URLs this week to address a bug where older invites pointed to deprecated endpoints — I’ve validated the new link and included a fallback dial-in.

Quick logistics / agenda (60m):
- 10m: architecture & goals review (Irene)
- 25m: technical deep-dive (Marissa — runtime, batching, quantization)
- 15m: compliance & deployment model Q&A (Aditya)
- 10m: next steps / rollouts / commercial checkpoints

I attached the Redwood product map and the discovery notes again for Anna. If you have SSO restrictions, we can provide a pre-authorized guest token for your domain — please let me know any domains to whitelist and I’ll coordinate with our security team.

Attachments: redwood-map.pdf, tech-deepdive.ics

—
Irene
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@stellaris.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-26T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite

Hi Simon — I’ll own the technical portion. Quick ask for prep so we can make the session actionable: can you share estimated concurrent sessions, peak tokens/sec, and whether you’ll want the private deployment (VPC) demo or hosted with dedicated capacity? Also any SSO provider details (Okta, AzureAD, etc.) so we can prepare the pre-authorized guest token if needed.

If the attendee list changes, ping me — we’ll keep the demo focused and bring a runtime engineer for live logs if you want. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@stellaris.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@stellaris.io>
Date: 2027-02-26T12:33:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling deep-dive after missing invite

Accepted — I received the new invite and link (Redwood secure meeting link v2). Attendees: Simon Liu, Anna Kovac (engineer), Lukas Meyer (SRE) — Lukas will ask about cert rotation and KV cache persistence.

We currently run a mix of spikes at month-end: baseline ~25 concurrent sessions with spikes to ~220 for 15–30 minutes; peak tokens/sec around 18k during those bursts. We’ll want to see the private deployment demo first, then hosted alternative. Our SSO is Okta.

See you Tue Mar 2, 10:00 CET.

Simon
